title: BudgetLedgerRepository
responsibility: Reads the budget ledger of a revision and appends reviewed events to it.

inputs.name: BudgetLedgerRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root retained by the repository; append() joins it with the configured ledger path before creating parent directories and appending events.

inputs.name: BudgetLedgerRepository.read.tree
inputs.description: Revision-specific source tree searched for the budget ledger; undefined or a tree without that path produces an empty ledger.

inputs.name: BudgetLedgerRepository.append.events
inputs.description: Reviewed baseline or approval events to serialize as one JSON line each in the append-only ledger.

outputs.name: BudgetLedgerRepository.read
outputs.description: Resolves with the source text, schema-valid events, and one error for each nonblank malformed line; an absent ledger resolves as empty.

outputs.name: BudgetLedgerRepository.append
outputs.description: Resolves after creating the ledger's parent directory and appending the events as JSON lines; filesystem failures reject the promise.
